primary_anchors.section: Methods / In-sample PRS prediction of phenotypes in UK Biobank with ten-fold cross-validation
Methods / PRS prediction of phenotypes in UK Biobank from external GWAS summary statistics

roles.use_summary: Constructed PRSice v2 scores for tenfold held-out prediction from imputed-phenotype and MTAG GWAS, and from external MDD GWAS; assessed binary and quantitative prediction with explicit covariates.

reported_settings.cross_validation: Ten folds; each GWAS uses 90 percent and prediction uses the held-out 10 percent.
reported_settings.prediction_metrics: Nagelkerke R-squared for binary traits; ordinary R-squared for quantitative traits.

roles.remaining_scope: The exact PRSice patch edition, full commands, clumping/threshold choices and original inputs remain unqualified. Do not assume a current release R-squared convention reproduces the paper metric.

primary_anchors.section: Results / Overall study design for developing and evaluating a multiancestry AD PRS
Methods / Training of PRS summation weights using ADGC data
Methods / PRS evaluation in the ADSP dataset

roles.use_summary: Used PRSice2 for clumping/thresholding across ancestry-specific LD panels and for scoring weights from LDpred2, PRS-CS and PRS-CSx, which the paper describes as without clumping parameters. Selected and combined PRSs in separate study procedures.

reported_settings.model_selection: Five random unrelated ADSP subsets; minimize coefficient of variation across effect sizes.
reported_settings.Bayesian_weight_scoring: The prose describes without clumping parameters; exact flags are absent.
reported_settings.downstream: Study-specific PRS scaling, weighted/unweighted summation and APOE-region exclusion.

roles.remaining_scope: A product name is not a patch version. The prose does not establish exact no-clump flags, commands, selected variants or LD resources. Native scoring assumes the user already selected/harmonized variants and supplies explicit masks.

reported_settings.cross_validation: Ten folds; 90 percent GWAS training and 10 percent test prediction.
reported_settings.outcomes: Target and nontarget phenotypes; predictive accuracy and PRS pleiotropy.
